axis_note.storage: NRRD, not HDF5. data_audit.json reports h5_file_count = 0.
axis_note.array_axes: axis 0 = X, axis 1 = Y, axis 2 = Z
axis_note.slice_plane: image[:, :, z] is one axial slice of shape (X, Y)
axis_note.why_not_last_dim_default: Axis 2 is Z because the 3D loader keeps NRRD sizes in (X, Y, Z) order. The last axis is Z only as a consequence of that order.
